pages.text: Reads a YAML document into a variable.

$(1)destination$() must be a single variable name; the function writes into it directly. Only the first document is read. On an error (TYPE_MISMATCH, INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNKNOWN_KEY, STRING_TOO_LONG) the variable stays unchanged.
$(li)$(1)source$() STRING: the YAML document$(li)$(1)destination$() variable: the variable that receives the values$(li)no results
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/FROM_YAML readError$(br)  PARAMETER source config ;$(br)  PARAMETER destination settings ;$()
